note: Set A contains multiple significant binding errors, incorrectly attributing C3X6 channels and L4X4X5/16 angles to Detail A5 (which shows W8X10 and L3X3X1/4) and placing W10X15 in Detail C2 (which shows W10X12). It also falsely claims a 10-inch depth for a C3X6 member. Set B is much more accurate, correctly binding sections to their specific details (e.g., L4X4X5/16 to Roof Framing, PL sizes to C1/C4) and capturing scales, though it shares one error regarding C3X6 in Detail 2.
